description: Write the commit message and pull request description for the current task. This is the only allowed PR format in this repo: use the returned PR description verbatim as the PR body and do not write your own or edit its sections (Changes, Scope, Locked behaviours and Decisions are facts from git and Stet). Pass `what` with 1–2 sentences on what changes for the user and why; that is the only part you write. Compares with the up-to-date remote base branch by default. Use runCheck to run the locked behaviours first.

base.description: Branch or commit to compare against, e.g. "main". Default: the up-to-date remote base branch, else where the scope was set.

what.description: 1–2 sentences: what changes for the user, and why

name: stet_pr
